engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Generation runs on a local GPU, or through a remote inference API. Pick whichever suits the machine you are on.

runtime.title: GPU Runtime
runtime.description: Local generation needs PyTorch, which is too large to ship inside the application. It is installed into the download folder chosen below, and nowhere else on this system.
runtime.cudaReady: CUDA is working, and generation can use this GPU.
runtime.mpsReady: Metal is working, and generation can use this GPU.
runtime.noDevice: PyTorch is loaded but reports no usable GPU. Generation will run on the processor.
runtime.restartRequired: Installed. Restart Bitwright to start using it.
runtime.unsupported: This system cannot be given a GPU runtime by this version.
runtime.cpuNote: No NVIDIA GPU was found, so this build generates on the processor, which is much slower.
runtime.confirmBody: This downloads {{download}} and leaves {{installed}} on the drive holding your download folder. Bitwright has to be restarted afterwards.
runtime.licenseBody: PyTorch is distributed under {{licenses}}. It is not covered by this application's licence.
runtime.nvidiaNotice: This build also carries NVIDIA's CUDA runtime libraries, which come under NVIDIA's own licence agreement rather than an open source one. Read it before you continue.
runtime.lowSpace: There is less room on that drive than this needs, which is {{needed}}.
runtime.removeBody: This deletes {{size}} from {{path}}. Local generation stops working until it is installed again.
runtime.repairHint: The runtime is missing {{names}}. Only those are downloaded, not the whole runtime.

providers.title: AI Providers
providers.description: The remote engine sends its requests to one of these. Add as many as you need and choose which one is in use. Requests go straight to the provider you configured and are not routed through Afterhours Studio.
providers.compatibility: A custom endpoint has to speak the OpenAI compatible API: GET {baseUrl}/models for the model list, and POST {baseUrl}/images/generations to generate. Any aggregator or router that imitates that shape works here.
providers.empty: No provider is configured yet. Add one to use the remote engine.
providers.limitReached: The maximum of {{max}} providers is already configured. Remove one before adding another.

storage.label: API keys are kept in
storage.file: a file only your account can read
storage.fileWarning: No system credential store was found on this machine, so keys are written to a plain file in your configuration directory. Any program running as you can read it.

form.name: Display name
form.baseUrlHint: No trailing slash needed. Plain http is accepted only for an endpoint on this machine, because a key sent over it would be readable on the way.
form.modelHint: The identifier this provider knows the model by.
form.apiKeyKept: Leave this blank to keep the key already stored.

test.failed: The connection test did not succeed

confirm.title: Remove this provider?
confirm.body: The stored API key is deleted along with it. This cannot be undone, and the key has to be pasted again to add the provider back.

remote.title: Remote API
remote.description: Requests go to the endpoint you configure here. They are not routed through Afterhours Studio.

models.title: Model Weights
models.description: Model weights are not part of this application and are not covered by its licence. Each one is downloaded on first use, under its own terms.
models.confirmBody: The weights are published by a third party under their own licence, which is not the licence of this application. Read it before you continue.
models.stopBody: Stopping deletes the part that has already been transferred, so downloading again starts from the beginning. Pause instead to keep it.
models.discardBody: The part already on this machine is deleted, and downloading again starts from the beginning.
models.removeBody: The file is deleted from this machine. Downloading it again is the only way back.

storage.title: Storage Location
storage.description: Model weights are several gigabytes each. Keep them on a volume with room, which need not be the one this application is installed on.
storage.isDefault: This is the default location, under your user profile.
storage.confirmBody: New downloads go here from now on. Weights already downloaded are not moved, and stay where they are.
storage.lowSpace: There is less room here than the largest model needs, which is {{needed}}.
storage.leftBehind: These stayed at the previous location and were not moved: {{models}}. They are still in {{path}}.
